description: This Java class defines the SendClaimMessageResponse, a specific response message type for claim responses from a Thing in the Eclipse Ditto framework. It includes methods for creating instances, parsing from JSON, and handling message metadata.

classes.name: SendClaimMessageResponse
classes.description: A final class representing the response message to a claim response command, parameterized over payload type T. It provides factory methods for creation and JSON deserialization, extending AbstractMessageCommandResponse.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Overrides to set headers for this message response.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Factory method to create instances using typed ThingId, message, status code, and headers. Deprecated version accepts String for thingId.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Creates a SendClaimMessageResponse instance from a JSON string or JSON object, with associated headers.
